items.title: Gucci Price Cuts Break Luxury's Biggest Taboo. Louis Vuitton Is Weighing It
items.summary: Follow-up analysis on Gucci's price cuts (Mercato tote and other bags down roughly 20-30%), framing the move as breaking an industry taboo that pressures Louis Vuitton to consider similar cuts. Notes Kering CEO Luca de Meo's admission that 'excessive pricing significantly impacted sales' alongside similar comments from Prada and Burberry executives, and flags that over half of luxury revenue depends on a shrinking middle-class consumer base. Critical/analytical angle on past overpricing.

items.title: Gucci to stage Cruise 2028 show in Shanghai
items.summary: Reports Gucci will hold its Cruise 2028 show in Shanghai on May 17, 2027, marking 30 years since its first China store opened and Demna's first Shanghai show for the house. Notes the announcement follows Kering CEO Luca de Meo's acknowledgment of a 'disconnect' between Gucci and Chinese consumers, and a 6% like-for-like sales decline for Gucci weighed down by weak in-store traffic in China; frames the show as a bet to rebuild the China relationship after flagship closures.

items.title: グッチが上海でクルーズコレクション開催へ 中国上陸30周年
items.summary: Japanese trade-press report confirming Gucci's Shanghai Cruise 2028 show on the 30th anniversary of its China entry, noting this is Demna's first show staged in Shanghai and situating the move within Gucci's broader China-market recovery push after a prolonged sales slump and store-network downsizing in the region.

items.title: 【GUCCI】上海にて、2028年クルーズコレクションのショーを開催
items.summary: Official Gucci Japan newsroom release confirming the Shanghai Cruise 2028 show date and framing it as a celebration of three decades in the Chinese market; largely promotional/official-channel content, counted as T1 official source but discounted as activation coverage for sentiment purposes.

items.title: 【GUCCI】「GucciCore」コレクション ローンチイベントに豪華セレブリティが集結
items.summary: Official release on the November 16 GucciCore (2027 Cruise) launch event at Gucci Aoyama, led by House Friend Ryosuke Yamada with roughly 15 other celebrities including Elaiza Ikeda and NiziU's Rima, plus a live set from hip-hop artist Kohjiya. Pure activation/official-channel coverage, discounted accordingly.

items.title: 山田涼介、池田エライザ、INI 西洸人、NiziU リマらがグッチ 青山に集結！
items.summary: Fashion-magazine snap coverage of the GucciCore launch event turnout at Gucci Aoyama, listing attendees Ryosuke Yamada, Elaiza Ikeda, INI's Nishi Koto and NiziU's Rima with photos of their styling choices. Activation coverage riding the ambassador/celebrity wave.

items.title: 山田涼介GUCCIの2027 クルーズコレクション "GucciCore"のローンチイベントに来場
items.summary: Fan-community blog post compiling photos and commentary on Yamada Ryosuke's appearance at the GucciCore launch event, describing fans' excitement over his styling and his remarks introducing the new Gucci collection to attendees. Legit fandom volume, magnitude-damped per sentiment rubric as activation-adjacent.

items.title: 古驰国内外价差到底差多少？2026年降价30%后真相说清+FAQ
items.summary: Weibo-syndicated explainer post calculating the remaining price gap between Gucci's mainland China prices and overseas prices after the 2026 roughly 30% price cuts, advising consumers on where to buy; representative of a wave of near-identical templated 'FAQ' finance-content posts about Gucci's price cuts, store closures, and Made-in-China sneakers circulating on Weibo this week. Treated as one representative sample; near-duplicate templated posts excluded per bot-filter guidance.

items.title: 古驰破天荒"中国制造"、Demna第二秀、降价30%自救，这波大新闻到底值不值得关注？
items.summary: Weibo commentary post discussing whether Gucci's 'Made in China' Drip sneaker, Demna's second show, and the roughly 30% price cuts amount to a genuine turnaround, noting consumer ambivalence: price-sensitive buyers welcome cheaper China-made product while brand-heritage-conscious buyers worry 'Made in China' signals quality downgrade versus the traditional Italian-manufacturing premium.

items.title: 구찌 가방 95만원 내렸다…콧대 높던 명품업계에 무슨 일이
items.summary: Reports Gucci cut the Mercato small tote from 4.45 million won to 3.5 million won (-21.3%), the first major Korean luxury price cut in roughly 11 years, framed as an industry-wide admission that years of price hikes backfired. Quotes Kering, Prada and Burberry leadership acknowledging overpricing hurt volumes. Critical/analytical angle, re-surfaced here as it continues driving today's Korean commentary cycle.

items.title: 불황 속 구찌는 가방값 30% 내렸는데…루이비통은 망설이는 '명품의 금기'
items.summary: Contrasts Gucci's unusual decision to cut select bag prices by up to 30% amid the prolonged luxury downturn against Louis Vuitton's reluctance to break the no-discount taboo, framing Gucci's move as a sign of competitive weakness within the house's multi-quarter sales slump rather than consumer generosity.

items.title: 명품 스니커즈 원가(공식 홈페이지 가격)

items.title: 닝닝, 전세계 반응 난리 난 파격 패션…과감한 노출 '힙해' [MD★스타]

items.title: Gucci selects Shanghai for Demna's Cruise 2028 fashion show
items.summary: Trade-press confirmation of the Shanghai Cruise 2028 show date and 30th-anniversary framing, noting Dior will stage its own Cruise 2028 show in Shanghai just three days earlier (May 14, 2027), setting up a direct competitive showcase moment between the two houses in the China market.
